title: A high throughput single molecule platform to study DNA supercoiling effect on protein-DNA interactions
authors: Huijin Lee; Jihee Hwang; Fahad Rashid; James A. London; Richard Fishel; James M. Berger; Sua Myong; Taekjip Ha
one_liner_zh: 该文开发高通量单分子平台研究DNA超螺旋对蛋白-DNA互作的影响，涉及Cas9和MutS，但非TF-DNA体系且方法以实验为主，AI/物理模拟方法有限，仅部分可借鉴。
abstract: DNA supercoiling significantly influences DNA metabolic pathways. To examine its impact on DNA-protein interactions at the single-molecule level, we developed a highly efficient and reliable protocol to modify plasmid DNA at specific sites, allowing us to label plasmids with fluorophores and biotin. We then induced negative and positive supercoiling in these plasmids using gyrase and reverse gyrase, respectively. Comparing supercoiled DNA with relaxed circular DNA, we assessed the effects of supercoiling on CRISPR-Cas9 and mismatch repair protein MutS. We found that negative DNA supercoiling exacerbates off-target effects in DNA unwinding by Cas9. For MutS, we observed both negative and positive DNA supercoiling enhances the binding interaction between MutS and a mismatched base pair but does not affect the rate of ATP-induced sliding clamp formation. These findings not only underscore the versatility of our protocol but also opens new avenues for exploring the intricate dynamics of protein-DNA interactions under the influences of supercoiling.
abstract_zh: DNA超螺旋显著影响DNA代谢途径。为了在单分子水平上研究其对DNA-蛋白质相互作用的影响，我们开发了一种高效且可靠的方案，用于在特定位点修饰质粒DNA，从而能够用荧光团和生物素标记质粒。随后，我们分别使用旋转酶（gyrase）和反向旋转酶（reverse gyrase）在这些质粒中诱导负超螺旋和正超螺旋。通过将超螺旋DNA与松弛环状DNA进行比较，我们评估了超螺旋对CRISPR-Cas9和错配修复蛋白MutS的影响。我们发现，负DNA超螺旋加剧了Cas9在DNA解旋过程中的脱靶效应。对于MutS，我们观察到负DNA超螺旋和正DNA超螺旋均增强了MutS与错配碱基对之间的结合相互作用，但不影响ATP诱导的滑动钳形成的速率。这些发现不仅凸显了我们方案的多功能性，还为探索超螺旋影响下蛋白质-DNA相互作用的复杂动态开辟了新途径。
